name: Wei jing Zhi Shu
source: A Honkai: Star Rail fan game focuses on Phainon which expands Amphoreus arc from version 3.4 to 3.7 and give Phainon a more coherent and satisfying ending. Planned to be released sequentially in 3 parts.
translation: 一款以Phainon为主题的《崩坏：星轨》粉丝游戏，将Amphoreus弧线从3.4版扩展至3.7版，并为Phainon提供了一个更加连贯和令人满意的结局。计划分3部分依次发布。
